title: WfGg Radar operational discovery and controlled runtime evolution
problem: Prevent abandoned Collector RUNNING cycles from poisoning Radar Autopilot while preserving V6.19.6 no-data continuation, valid historical evidence, and hard stops for true global/auth/network failures.
goals: Detect a joined Collector cycle as stale only when Collector DB proves it has remained RUNNING beyond a conservative 15-minute threshold.
Close only that proven stale Collector cycle as FAILED with STALE_RUNNING_CYCLE_RECOVERED_V6197, then allow a fresh discovery cycle to start.
Fail closed to the pre-V6.19.7 join/wait behavior when stale-cycle inspection is unavailable or ambiguous.
Preserve V6.19.6 SEED_SKIPPED_NO_DATA continuation after three conservative no-data failures.
Preserve valid historical 9/9 evidence and never count stale, failed, partial, or skipped cycles as confirmed clusters.
Keep authentication, network, connector, system and infrastructure failures blocking.
Qualify and deploy the change through ChaCha DEV with a guard-only pilot probe that executes no Last War scan.
non_goals: Do not reclassify AUTH, NETWORK, CONNECTOR, SYSTEM, timeout, ingest, decode, disk, memory or permission failures as no-data.
Do not recover RUNNING cycles younger than 15 minutes.
Do not recover a cycle when its start time or Collector DB state cannot be proven safely.
Do not delete or rewrite valid historical Collector evidence.
Do not change the V6.19.5 12-hour sliding Radar UI session policy.
Do not execute a real game scan during the pilot guard probe.

current_change.purpose: Recover Collector cycles proven stale beyond 15 minutes so an abandoned RUNNING cycle cannot trap Autopilot or cascade into FAILURE_LIMIT.

acceptance_criteria: The connector reports Autopilot version v6.19.7.
A joined Collector cycle is eligible for recovery only when Collector DB reports RUNNING and its started_at age is at least 15 minutes.
Stale-cycle inspection failure is fail-closed: the existing join/wait behavior is preserved and no recovery mutation occurs.
A proven stale cycle is finished as FAILED with STALE_RUNNING_CYCLE_RECOVERED_V6197 before a fresh cycle is started.
V6.19.6 AUTOPILOT_NO_DATA and SEED_SKIPPED_NO_DATA behavior remains present.
AUTOPILOT_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURE_LIMIT and AUTOPILOT_AUTH_FAILED remain blocking for true failures.
Valid historical 9/9 evidence is preserved and stale/failed/skipped cycles never increment ConfirmedClusters.
Pilot installation is SHA-pinned, rollback-capable and verified with no Last War scan or Collector mutation during the guard probe.
Production promotion requires a separate explicit human approval.
After the guard-only pilot passes, a separate explicitly approved functional pilot may run exactly one normal @federated:8131 search to verify recovery of the observed stale Collector cycle.

The functional pilot must prove the stale cycle is marked FAILED with STALE_RUNNING_CYCLE_RECOVERED_V6197 and that a fresh @federated:8131 cycle reaches a terminal status before the pilot window closes.
The functional pilot keeps Last War READ-ONLY and limits Collector mutation to stale-cycle recovery plus the fresh targeted evidence cycle.
architecture_invariants: GitHub stores code, branches, CI and release artifacts.
ChaCha DEV on ChaChaVPS is the runtime orchestrator.
ChaChaNas remains authoritative persistent storage for project data and backups.
VPS is runtime-oriented and not the authoritative durable project store.
Producer and verifier responsibilities remain separated.
